sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Eighth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXV OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(EIGHTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE XXXV OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance,
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 25th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS: 1(18)/70-IX/7115,
dated 25-9-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--- (1) This Ordinance may be the North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Eighth Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
